scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace packages/db && npm run build --workspace packages/db && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace packages/db && npm run build --workspace packages/db && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace packages/db && npm run build --workspace packages/db && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run db:generate --workspace packages/db && npm run build --workspace packages/db && npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web && npm run test --workspace packages/shared
